In an interview with Bret Baier on Fox News (posted here), Former UAP Task Force Director Jay Stratton was asked: “Does the Government have nonhuman craft in its possession? and answered: “Yes, it does.” To the follow-up question: “Have you seen one with your eyes?” Jay replied: “I have seen non-human beings and non-human craft in my own eyes.” Bret asked: “Where are these craft now? Are they being reverse engineered? Does the government have them? Is it private companies that have them?” and Jay answered: “Bret, both the defense contractor, community, and the government have a craft of non-human origin. There is an ongoing program to capture and reverse engineer this technology, and really, we’re in a secret Cold War race to do that.” Brett asked: Why haven’t we heard about this? Why, you know, all of these releases from the government, that we have these videos, and some of them are very compelling, others not so much. And people say: `Well, I want to receive the real stuff.’ Why haven’t we seen the real stuff?” to which Jay said: “Well, the people who have had this 80-year monopoly on the topic believe that the secret is so intense that the American people cannot handle it. I believe that there may be aspects of this that are so intense that they can’t share it, but they can share with the American people the basic fact that we are not alone. People can handle that.”

I wholeheartedly agree with Bret Baier and the general public: “Digital data or material evidence please, the time is ripe to go beyond verbal testimonies!” We want to see evidence beyond a reasonable doubt that Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) are linked to non-human technologies. This should not be a matter of faith because according to Jay there is material evidence for this connection.

After meeting Jay a month ago at the PhenomeCon 2026 conference in Utah, I invited him to speak with the UAP Science Advisory Council (https://uapsac.com/). Jay did not respond to my invitation, even after it was repeated by the Council member, Dr. Tim Gallaudet. Why is it a higher priority for Jay to speak with Bret than with a Council that is dedicated to chasing the evidence and releasing it to the public?

A day after my conference presentation, I attended a meeting of the UAP Governing Board at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI), as mentioned here. This board, with comprehensive representation across the executive branch, military and intelligence community, vigorously follows the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE) and would be delighted to review any evidence for technologies of non-human origin. Obviously, any groundbreaking revelation about alien intelligence would be of great political benefit to the Trump administration. Why can’t anyone offer President Trump a guided tour to an alien spacecraft or at least some footage of alien bodies?

A few months ago, Aaron Lucas, Principal Deputy Director of National Intelligence, released a landmark memorandum waiving all prior non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), secrecy commitments, and oaths regarding UAPs for all current and former government employees and contractors (as described here). This historic ODNI guidance legally cleared the path for Jay Stratton to come forward and disclose information to designated government task forces without fear of professional or legal ruin. By now, Jay must have revealed everything he knows to the PURSUE team. However, so far the PURSUE team has not found evidence that links UAP to non-human technologies.

ODNI’s institutional assessment is a double-edged sword for Stratton. On one hand, the ODNI formally cleared the restrictions that allowed him to publish his memoir and validated his task force’s data. On the other hand, the ODNI’s official intelligence conclusions stop short of confirming non-human intelligence, classifying the released materials strictly as “unresolved anomalies” requiring further scientific evaluation.

There is no doubt that Jay Stratton has a high professional credibility, as he served for over 32 years on the battlefield and as a senior defense executive. He held a civilian rank equivalent to a two-star general and regularly contributed to the President’s Daily Briefing.

He was the director of the Pentagon’s official UAP Task Force (UAPTF), which received a National Intelligence Meritorious Unit Citation from DNI Avril Haines for their rigorous, whole-of-government work on UAP data. While his resume is undeniable, the claims Jay makes are not corroborated by publicly verifiable data.

In the six tranches of released of UAP data through the PURSUE files (https://www.war.gov/ufo/), the vast majority of military UAP encounters can be attributed to conventional objects, such as drones, weather balloons, foreign spy aircraft, or airborne clutter. The first paper from the UAP Science Advisory Council, posted here last week, shows that some of the declassified UAP are likely birds.

This does not mean that some small fraction of UAP cannot represent encounters with alien technology. To figure this out, we need better digital data or material evidence than released so far. We do injustice to this important research frontier by either approaching it with a skeptical or a faith-based mind. In the future, the UAP Science Advisory council aims to conduct new experiments with state-of-the-art sensors to obtain high quality scientific data on UAP in an attempt to identify their nature (similarly to the Galileo Project data discussed here and here).

We have to see the spacecraft that Jay claims to have seen (or data associated with these spacecraft) in order to accept his claim. Seeing that evidence does not require going to the field with new sensors. If someone holds the spacecraft, that someone can show it to the President of the United States. Jay claims that the president is not aware of the spacecraft despite the unprecedented interest in seeing it by the White House. We must see the evidence to gauge whether Jay is speaking the truth.

The truth will only be revealed through digital or material evidence, collected and analyzed by scientific instruments. This is how humanity discovered that Earth is not at the center of the Universe and this is the only way we will find whether humans are not at the top of the cosmic food chain.
